description-zh: PHP程序的入口函数示例，包含命令行参数处理和错误处理
description-en: Entry point function example for PHP programs, including command line arguments and error handling
code:
<?php

/**
 * 主程序入口函数
 * @param array $argv 命令行参数数组
 * @return int 退出状态码
 */
function main(array $argv = []): int {
    try {
        // 设置错误处理
        set_error_handler(function($severity, $message, $file, $line) {
            throw new ErrorException($message, 0, $severity, $file, $line);
        });
        
        // 打印程序信息
        echo "Program: {$argv[0]}\n";
        
        // 打印命令行参数
        $args = array_slice($argv, 1);
        echo "Arguments count: " . count($args) . "\n";
        echo "Arguments: " . implode(', ', $args) . "\n";
        
        // 程序主要逻辑
        $name = $args[0] ?? 'World';
        echo "Hello, {$name}!\n";
        
        return 0;
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "Error: {$e->getMessage()}\n");
        return 1;
    }
}

// 如果是从命令行运行
if (PHP_SAPI === 'cli' && basename($argv[0]) === basename(__FILE__)) {
    exit(main($argv));
}

description-zh: 返回去除重复值且保持原顺序的数组
description-en: Return an array without duplicates preserving order
code:
<?php
function array_unique_order(array $arr): array {
    $seen = [];
    $out = [];
    foreach ($arr as $v) {
        if (!isset($seen[$v])) {
            $seen[$v] = true;
            $out[] = $v;
        }
    }
    return $out;
}

description-zh: 解析 JSON 字符串为数组或对象，失败返回 null
description-en: Decode JSON string to array/object; return null on failure
code:
<?php
function json_decode_safe(string $json_str, bool $assoc = true) {
    $data = json_decode($json_str, $assoc);
    if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
        return null;
    }
    return $data;
}

description-zh: 将数据编码为 JSON 字符串（UTF-8 不转义中文）
description-en: Encode data to JSON (preserve UTF-8 characters)
code:
<?php
function json_encode_safe($data): string {
    return json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
}

description-zh: 反转 UTF-8 字符串 (按字符而不是字节)
description-en: Reverse UTF-8 string by characters not bytes
code:
<?php
function utf8_reverse(string $s): string {
    preg_match_all('/./us', $s, $m);
    return implode('', array_reverse($m[0]));
}

description-zh: 按字符长度安全截断 UTF-8 字符串并可添加后缀
description-en: Safely truncate UTF-8 string by characters with suffix
code:
<?php
function utf8_truncate(string $s, int $limit, string $suffix = '...'): string {
    if (mb_strlen($s, 'UTF-8') <= $limit) return $s;
    return mb_substr($s, 0, $limit, 'UTF-8') . $suffix;
}

description-zh: 读取文件内容为字符串（失败返回 null）
description-en: Read file contents as string or return null
code:
<?php
function file_read(string $filename): ?string {
    if (!is_readable($filename)) return null;
    $data = @file_get_contents($filename);
    return $data === false ? null : $data;
}

description-zh: 使用生成器逐行读取文件（内存友好）
description-en: Yield lines from file efficiently using generator
code:
<?php
function file_line_generator(string $filename): \Generator {
    if (!is_readable($filename)) return;
    $fh = fopen($filename, 'rb');
    if (!$fh) return;
    try {
        while (($line = fgets($fh)) !== false) {
            yield rtrim($line, "\r\n");
        }
    } finally {
        fclose($fh);
    }
}

description-zh: 检查文本是否匹配给定正则模式
description-en: Check if text matches regex pattern
code:
<?php
function regex_is_match(string $pattern, string $text): bool {
    return preg_match($pattern, $text) === 1;
}

description-zh: 使用 file_get_contents 发送简单 GET 请求（失败返回 null）
description-en: Send simple HTTP GET request using file_get_contents; null on failure
code:
<?php
function http_get(string $url, int $timeout = 5): ?string {
    $ctx = stream_context_create(['http' => ['method' => 'GET', 'timeout' => $timeout]]);
    $data = @file_get_contents($url, false, $ctx);
    return $data === false ? null : $data;
}

description-zh: 计算字符串的 SHA-256 十六进制哈希
使用 DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR 拼接路径
code:
<?php
function path_join(array $segments): string {
    return implode(DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, array_map(function($s) {
        return trim($s, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR);
    }, $segments));
}

description-zh: 使用 stream_context 发送 JSON Body 的 POST 请求，支持超时，失败返回 null
description-en: Send POST with JSON body via stream_context; timeout supported; null on failure
code:
<?php
function http_post_json(string $url, $data, int $timeout = 5): ?string {
    $payload = json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
    $ctx = stream_context_create([
        'http' => [
            'method' => 'POST',
            'header' => "Content-Type: application/json\r\n" .
                        "Accept: application/json\r\n",
            'content' => $payload,
            'timeout' => $timeout
        ]
    ]);
    $res = @file_get_contents($url, false, $ctx);
    return $res === false ? null : $res;
}
